For a demonstration of a voltage divider circuit, see @fig-circuit.

```{python}
#| label: fig-circuit
#| fig-cap: "Voltage divider circuit"
import schemdraw
schemdraw.use('matplotlib')
import schemdraw.elements as elm
with schemdraw.Drawing() as d:
    d += elm.SourceV().up().label('10V')
    d += elm.Resistor().right().label('1kΩ')
    d += elm.Resistor().down().label('2kΩ')
    d += elm.Line().left()
```
